info.title: ClipForge API
info.description: Backend service for auto-creating clips from streams (Phase 4).

post.description:
Create a new user with hashed password and return JWT tokens.

Raises ``409 Conflict`` if the email is already registered.

post.summary: Log in with email and password
post.description:
Verify credentials and return JWT tokens.

Raises ``401 Unauthorized`` on invalid email or password.

Accept a valid refresh token and return a fresh access + refresh
token pair.

Raises ``401 Unauthorized`` if the refresh token is invalid or
the user no longer exists.

get.description: Return the profile of the user identified by the access token.

post.summary: Create a new project from a video link
post.description:
Parse a Twitch, YouTube, or Kick link, check for duplicates for this user,
persist a queued project, and enqueue the metadata fetch worker task.

get.summary: Get paginated list of projects for the current user
get.description: Return paginated projects owned by the authenticated user.

post.summary: Create a new project by uploading a video file
post.description:
Accept an MP4, MOV, MKV, or WEBM video file, store it in MinIO,
extract its duration & thumbnail via ffmpeg/ffprobe, and create a ready project.

get.description: Retrieve a project by ID. Returns 404 if not found or unauthorized.

delete.summary: Delete a project and its stored files
delete.description: Delete a project and any associated assets in MinIO.

schema.title: Response Delete Project Projects  Project Id  Delete

post.summary: Retry metadata fetching for a failed project
post.description: Reset a failed project to queued and trigger metadata extraction again.

get.summary: Server-Sent Events (SSE) stream for real-time project status updates
get.description:
Streams Server-Sent Events (SSE) with status updates for the project.
Subscribes to the Redis pub/sub channel 'project_events:{project_id}'.

post.summary: Start a new moment detection analysis run

get.summary: List all analysis runs for a project

get.summary: Get status and details of an analysis run

delete.summary: Delete an analysis run and its generated moments

schema.title: Response Delete Analysis Analyses  Analysis Id  Delete

schema.title: Response Get Analysis Moments Analyses  Analysis Id  Moments Get

schema.title: Response Get Analysis Signals Analyses  Analysis Id  Signals Get

post.description:
Create draft clips from detected analysis moments.
Idempotent per moment: returns existing clip if one already exists for (analysis_id, moment_id).
Create a custom manual clip on a project timeline.

get.description: List clips belonging to current user with query filters and pagination.

post.description: Execute bulk actions ('export' or 'delete') on a list of clip IDs.

get.description: Retrieve details of a single clip.

patch.description:
Update clip title or edit_state with optimistic concurrency check.
Raises 409 conflict when payload.version does not match database version.

delete.description: Delete a clip and remove its preview and render files from storage.

post.description: Duplicate an existing clip into an independent copy.
Start or queue generation of the 480p proxy, waveform, and thumbnails.

get.description: Check whether the preview proxy and waveform are ready.

Stream preview MP4 proxy with standard HTTP Range support (status 206).
Enables seeking in HTML5 video players.
Retrieve waveform peak values (0..1) for the clip preview range.
Retrieve thumbnails sprite sheet information for scrub preview.

post.description: Queue a video render job for a clip with resolution, fps, and quality options.

get.description: List render jobs for a specific clip.
Retrieve the status and output metadata of a render job.

post.description: Cancel an active or queued render job.

get.description:
Generate a short-lived presigned download URL and a sanitized filename
for a completed render.

Server-Sent Events endpoint streaming preview and render events for current user.
Optional query parameter ?clip_id= filters events for that clip.

Return global editor and export configurations:
- max_clip_seconds: Maximum allowed clip duration.
- preview_padding_sec: Padding added before/after clip in preview proxy.
- export_resolutions: Supported export resolutions list.
Lightweight health-check used by Docker and load balancers.
